summary.value: Adds a Bounty to your sheet — anything you are hunting: an NPC, a place, an artifact.

system.description: Adds a Bounty to your sheet — anything you are hunting: an NPC, a place, an artifact. Spend 1 Fabula Point to invoke it as a Trait (reroll) or as a Bond with strength (1 + Bounty Hunter level ÷ 5). Re-point it on level-up, on a rest, or with an Opportunity.
